summary: The liveness, well-formed-exit, and conformance checks derive every condition workflowAdmit reads over the registered definitions. An advancing action with no active contract refuses at the contract step except approve_contract. Complete-step correction admits one or more active contracts so a duplicated projection recovers through the same shared gate. Active-contract confirmation records the authenticated coordinator, retaining investigation and verdict prerequisites.
title: The admission model derives every condition and two strands recover
